an11.19:2.1: siyā nu kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā neva paṭhaviyaṃ paṭhavīsaññī assa na āpasmiṃ āposaññī assa na tejasmiṃ tejosaññī assa na vāyasmiṃ vāyosaññī assa na ākāsānañcāyatane ākāsānañcāyatanasaññī assa na viññāṇañcāyatane viññāṇañcāyatanasaññī assa na ākiñcaññāyatane ākiñcaññāyatanasaññī assa na nevasaññānāsaññāyatane nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññī assa na idhaloke idhalokasaññī assa na paraloke paralokasaññī assa yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tatrāpi na saññī assa saññī ca pana assāti.
an11.19:2.2: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an11.19:3.1: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
an11.19:3.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
